news.title: New minor risk - Insider selling
news.body: There has been significant insider selling in the company's shares over the past 3 months. Total value of shares sold: ₹8.0m This is considered a minor risk. There are several reasons why an insider may be selling, including to cover a tax obligation or pay for some other expense. However, we generally consider it a negative if insiders have been selling, especially if they do so below the current price. It implies that they considered a lower price to be reasonable. This is a weak signal, but if there is a pattern of unexplained selling, it can be a sign the insider believes the company's stock is overpriced. news.title: Pro Clb Global Limited Announces Resignation of Mr. Amrit Nirmal Chamaria Managing Director , Effective January 16, 2026
news.body: Pro Clb Global Limited announced that Mr. Amrit Nirmal Chamaria (DIN: 02062349), Managing Director of the Company, has resigned from the position of Managing Director with effective from 16th January, 2026 due to personal reasons. The Board of Directors of the Company deeply appreciates his valuable contribution and support during his term as a Managing Director of the Company.

news.body: Pro Clb Global Limited announced that Mr. Amrit Nirmal Chamaria has resigned from the position of Directorship with effective from 16th January, 2026 due to personal reasons.

news.title: Pro Clb Global Limited Announces Resignation of Non-Executive Director Niraj Nirmal Kumar Chamaria, Effective January 16, 2026
news.body: PRO CLB GLOBAL LIMITED announced that Mr. Niraj Nirmal Kumar Chamaria (DIN: 02062351), Non-Executive Director of the Company, has resigned from the position of Non-Executive Director effective from January 16, 2026 due to personal reasons. The resignation was communicated in compliance with Regulation 30 read with Para A of Part A of Schedule III of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, and SEBI Circular No. SEBI/HO/CFD/CFD-PoD1/P/CIR/2023/123 dated July 13, 2023. Mr. Chamaria confirmed that there is no other material reason for his resignation. The company is required to file Form DIR 12 with the Registrar of Companies (ROC) in accordance with the Companies Act 2013.

news.title: Pro Clb Global Limited Announces Resignation of Non-Executive Independent Directors Manish Agrawal and Yashvi Chaitanya Shah, Effective January 16, 2026
news.body: PRO CLB GLOBAL LIMITED announced that Mr. Manish Agrawal (DIN: 01962004), Non-Executive Independent Director, and Ms. Yashvi Chaitanya Shah (DIN: 08002543), Non-Executive Independent Director, have resigned from the position of Non-Executive Independent Director effective from January 16, 2026 due to pre-occupations and other professional commitments. Ms. Yashvi Chaitanya Shah holds directorship in RAJSHREE POLYPACK LIMITED. The resignation was communicated in compliance with Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

news.title: Additional Non-Executive Director recently sold ₹649k worth of stock
news.body: On the 24th of December, Niraj Nirmal Chamaria sold around 25k shares on-market at roughly ₹26.01 per share. This transaction amounted to 3.5% of their direct individual holding at the time of the trade. This was the largest sale by an insider in the last 3 months. This was the only on-market transaction from insiders over the last 12 months.
